history.name: A character the fonts can't draw fails the build
history.description: Before an edition is printed, every character in it is checked against what the embedded type can actually draw, and anything outside it stops the build with the characters named. The bundled faces cover Western and Central European writing, so European names and prose are safe; anything further afield is reported as a build failure instead of quietly substituting a system font for a glyph or two — which is the sort of thing nobody notices until the client is holding the document.
history.dev_notes: checkGlyphs() against assets/fonts/coverage.json, the intersection of every bundled face's cmap.
